title: Trash/Recycle Bin View
purpose: Displays deleted files scoped to current project with restore and permanent delete options
acceptance: shall show snapshot timestamp of when trash was last read
shall display deleted items with original path, size/count, and deletion time
shall allow restore action to put items back to original location
shall allow permanent delete (purge) with confirmation
shall show error if item is no longer in trash when action is clicked
shall refresh list after any restore or purge action
